images.title: Xbox 360 Controller (wired and wireless), white
images.author: unreal-ng
images.terms: vector drawing from measured dimensions; photos used as references only, nothing traced

references.source: Microsoft Xbox 360 Controller for Windows spec sheet (XBX0008), as neweggbusiness.com lists it

references.what: FIG. 2, top plan view: the outline (trace.py, the dashed line filled, the right half mirrored, 104.7 mm deep at 152 mm against 107 mm with the triggers), the grey lower shell's edge, the bumpers, the creases, every control's position and size
references.author: Microsoft Corporation (inventors J. A. Hayes, M. Baseflug)
references.use: measured geometry only (trace.py outline, positions on a grid); no pixels shipped

references.what: colours: white top shell, light grey lower shell, grey sticks and D-pad, the jewel face buttons, the ring of light and its numbers, the BACK / START legends
references.author: I G

references.what: the wired and the wireless controller share this shell (the wireless one's battery pack is underneath, its connect button on the top edge between the bumpers, not seen from above)
references.author: Evan-Amos

references.what: the triggers' rise behind the bumpers (2.3 mm, the spec's depth less the drawing's)
